STATUS: ANSWER
The `-l, --merge-logic` option of `bcftools annotate` sets how multiple annotation values are combined when several regions overlap one record. The rules are `first` (use the first value), `append` (keep duplicates), `append-missing` (append even missing dot values), `unique` (drop duplicates), `sum`, `avg`, `min` and `max` [bcftools_manual#h019]. `sum` and `avg` apply to numeric fields only, and the option is experimental [bcftools_manual#h019]. It is intended for BED or TAB-delimited annotation files and works only when REF and ALT or BEG and END columns are present. Multiple rules can be comma-separated or given repeatedly [bcftools_manual#h019].
